bash.why: Baseline gate: force-pushing main destroys shared history; RULES 9 pushes only clean, green states.
Baseline gate: recursive delete outside the project tree is unrecoverable and never required by any law.
Baseline gate + RULES 9: a broken change is reverted via normal commits, not by rewriting shared branch state.
ENV.md Deploy: lowercase english commit messages, no co-author tags.
allow: git commit -m tighten the snap tolerance to 0.1mm

bash.why: ENV.md Deploy: wrangler deploy is DAMLA'S step; the agent must never deploy or claim the worker is live.
CLAUDE.md + RULES.md: STRATEGY.md is never loaded into agent context (stale/contradictory strategy poisons the loop).
CLAUDE.md SEO: no hand-editing HTML — fix the generator (gen-*-pages.mjs) and regenerate everything.

tail -1/-2 clips the 'X% tests passed' verdict line, making green runs unreadable as pass/fail; use tail -5 or grep 'tests passed'. REPAIRED 2026-08-03: the old pattern was 'ctest[^|]*\|\s*tail\s+-(n\s*)?[12]\b' and could never fire — rabadon matches each rule against a PARSED SEGMENT surface and a '|' is the segment boundary, so no surface ever contains one (measured: gate exit 0 on 'ctest --test-dir engine/build | tail -1'). The tail segment is judged alone, so the ctest context is not visible; the pattern therefore fires on a bare 'tail -1' with no file operand, which is the piped shape. 'tail -1 Logs/run.log' and 'tail -20' still pass.
new_flats, benchmark-58, dataset, engine/dist and patterns_real are copyrighted never-push sources (CLAUDE.md GİZLİLİK); explicitly adding them to the index must be blocked before it happens.

ctest -N / --show-only only LISTS tests and runs nothing; its exit code is 0 whatever the suite does, so it is never a pass/fail signal — run the real suite. REPAIRED 2026-08-03: the old pattern was 'ctest\s+-N\b.*grep\s+-c' and could never fire, because it needed the pipe and the parsed surface splits on it (measured: gate exit 0 on 'ctest -N | grep -c Test'). The dry run is now refused on its own segment, where it is visible.
Repo holds untracked unignored dirs (Logs/, patterns_real additions) that must never be staged wholesale, and other Claude sessions write in this tree; explicit-path git add stays allowed.

protectedPaths.why: RULES 4: golden diff stays byte-identical when features are off; the golden is a reference, not a thing to edit into passing.

CLAUDE.md SEO: 'Elle HTML düzenleme YOK' — THESE dirs are produced by gen-pattern-pages.mjs / gen-collection-pattern.mjs / gen-style-pages.mjs / gen-guide.mjs; change the generator. Root pages (index/create/closet/studio/...) are hand-written and hand-edited (scoped 2026-07-28: the old web/.*html match blocked legitimate root-page work).
CLAUDE.md SEO: sitemap+robots are emitted by the page generators, not hand-maintained.
CLAUDE.md + RULES.md: STRATEGY.md is banned from agent context; an agent that cannot read it cannot legitimately write it.

pushGate.why: RULES 9: ctest must be fully green before any push; a change that breaks a test is reverted, not pushed.
pushGate.testHint: cmake --build engine/build -j8 && ctest --test-dir engine/build --output-on-failure (engine-check harness = full draft matrix, must be FULLY green)
